text:
maria: Incoming case from AcmeGames — players in Korea reporting 300-400ms extra latency since yesterday evening. They say requests are routing to eu-pop1 instead of ap-northeast-2. Sample curl they provided (redacted token):

maria: curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=ap-northeast-2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Client-Region: ap-northeast-2" \
  -H "X-Region-Preference: eu,ap-northeast-2" \
  --data '\"{\\\"prompt\\\":\\\"hello\\\"}\"'

maria: Router logs show selected_region=eu-pop1 for these requests. Billing shows EU pricing too. Customer is escalated and wants root cause + mitigation.

aj: Quick question — are they going through a CDN/proxy? That X-Region-Preference header looks like something injected by a gateway.
aj: Can you paste a raw header dump (with auth redacted)?

maria: Header dump from customer (auth removed):
  Host: api.redwood.ai
  Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
  Accept: application/json
  X-Client-Region: ap-northeast-2
  X-Region-Preference: eu,ap-northeast-2
  User-Agent: acme-game-server/2.4

lee: I think I know this one — some enterprise proxies append a CSV-style preference header. Our router currently treats the header value as a single token and prefers header over query param. If header starts with "eu" it will route EU even if query param explicit says ap-northeast-2.
aj: I attempted a quick repro from staging using their exact headers and query param. Staging router decision: 

```
2026-03-16T19:03:22Z router[decider]: incoming region param=ap-northeast-2
router: X-Region-Preference header found: "eu,ap-northeast-2"
router: parse_header -> token[0] = "eu"
router: choose_region = eu-pop1
```

aj: So two problems: (1) header precedence is higher than explicit query param, and (2) CSV token parsing doesn't trim or validate tokens. That combination causes misroute to EU.

maria: Customer wants immediate mitigation — can we force their org to ap-northeast-2 while we fix the parser?

lee: Two paths: (A) Immediate control-plane override for that org/api-key to force ap-northeast-2 (fast, manual), or (B) emergency patch to router to change precedence (riskier to deploy quickly). I recommend override for now.
aj: I can apply an override but need confirmed org id and API key. @maria?

maria: Provided org id and API key in the ticket (ticket #25321). Please proceed.

ops-bot: Route override applied: org=acme-games -> force_region=ap-northeast-2 (propagated to edge caches, ttl=60s).

maria: Customer confirms latency dropped back to expected levels (~35ms). They're happy and dropped escalation.

lee: Filing P1 bug: "router: header precedence and CSV parsing bug -> misroutes when X-Region-Preference contains CSV list". Assign to aj. Required work: parser update to split on comma, trim tokens, validate tokens against known regions, prefer explicit query param/route param over injected headers, unit tests, and docs update for header precedence.
aj: Will open PR today with tests and a small patch that enforces query param precedence and CSV parsing. If tests pass we'll release to canary then prod.

maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: We'll follow up with the customer post-mortem and note the proxy injection pattern in our KB article so other customers know what to look for.
